title: Terraform for Enterprise Production
summary: A practical guide to building and running Terraform in enterprise AWS: how to structure modules, keep state safe, refactor without downtime, and add automated security checks.
closingBody: I'm happy to go into more detail on any of this: module design trade-offs, moving state safely, or security scanning in CI/CD.

title: Enterprise Cloud Migration: Assess, Mobilize & Modernize
summary: An architecture and cost guide for enterprise cloud migrations: rapid (4–6 week) versus deep (3–4 month) assessments, 3-year cost modelling including Savings Plans and Microsoft licensing, landing zone design, wave planning, and modernizing along the way.
closingBody: I'm happy to go into more detail on any of this: scoping an assessment, building the cost model, or planning migration waves.

title: Kubernetes from Zero to Production on Amazon EKS
summary: A path from never having used Kubernetes to running Amazon EKS in production. Part 1 covers the basics on a free local cluster. Part 2 teaches the core concepts: how a cluster works, workloads, networking, storage, access, and packaging. Part 3 moves to Amazon EKS and builds the platform. Part 4 covers the real challenges of operating it: delivery, GitOps, autoscaling, observability, incident triage, and upgrades.
closingBody: I'm happy to go into more detail on any of this: how the pieces fit together, ingress costs, RBAC design, or how I triage incidents.
